=== logs --follow
$ orion-node logs --follow

 level  info+   source  nginx   search  press /

 14:32:05 info   nginx   GET /health 502 3ms

 │ source   nginx · /var/log/nginx/error.log                                        │

  ↑↓  move  enter  details  f  follow  p  pause  l  level  /  search  q  quit

=== log viewer states
  ● Following   live
  ◐ Paused +14   new lines held until you press p
  ○ Snapshot   not a terminal, or --no-follow
  ◐ No reply   daemon not running: reading the local spool
 no log entries match  level ≥ warn · search "timeout"  press esc to clear

--- notes
NOTE One focused full-screen view: The only place that takes the whole terminal, because reading a stream needs the room. q returns to your prompt with scrollback intact.
NOTE Select a line: Arrow keys move a cursor; enter opens a details drawer with source, fields and whether the line reached Core.
NOTE Header chips are the status: Follow state and daemon connection are chips, using the same words as status.
NOTE Built from: bubbles/viewport, textinput for search, huh select for the level and source pickers.
NOTE Snapshot when piped: Without a TTY or with --lines, it prints plain lines, one per log entry.
